tvla_transition_samples.explanation: N_cyc = 27,269 counts the clock cycles in which the FSM is not idle: 27,268 cycles before it enters S_DONE plus the S_DONE cycle that raises the done flag. The Hamming-distance trace has one sample per clock edge from the first edge after the start-capturing edge up to the edge that enters S_DONE, i.e. 27,268 consecutive transition samples (the first is taken against the pre-launch reset snapshot). The S_DONE cycle is not sampled: it changes only the 1-bit done flag, whose toggle is input independent.
